title: Make A Plan to Remember
verse: He told the Israelites, “When your children someday ask their fathers, ‘What do these stones represent?’
observation: It’s so easy to forget God’s faithfulness because there is always something else over the horizon. The nation of Israel is about to have so much going on, it would be possible for them to forget even something as amazing as the Jordan River parting. The best chance to not forget is to plan for it. They set up a memorial so it would help them remember. This is a great idea.
application: Set up ways to help you remember God’s faithfulness. Journal every time God does something.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us remember that You have always been faithful.
